legacy-review-001.reason: The reply answers criticism of Sam Halladay and is followed by an explicit female Halladay reference. It does not identify the respondent as Cole Richardson.

legacy-review-002.reason: John was out watching me describes a person being observed. The respondent commenting that they know what is up is not identified as John.

legacy-review-003.reason: The initial hail addresses Hawkins, but both fresh ASR passes recover a subsequent turn to Cox before 14590020 joins the broader discussion of unruly children. This is weak evidence for Hawkins on that radio; the change of addressee is material.

legacy-review-005--colton-j-rothe.reason: Colton is discussed as not working; asking who Colton is is not self-identification as Colton.

legacy-review-007.reason: The next radio asks Cox a new question about Walmart instead of answering the instruction to Hawkins. This is another next-speaker attribution risk.

legacy-review-009.reason: The caller has already thanked the intended recipient before 14590107 reports that a door popped open. The door report is not a response to Greg's parking-lot instruction.

legacy-review-010--anthony-s-neil.reason: The name is mentioned as someone excluded from lunch plans. The following greeting is not an answer to a hail to Neil.

legacy-review-018.reason: The respondent explicitly says That was Somerville asking, rather than identifying himself as McKay.

legacy-review-023.reason: The respondent says He said he is in the north parking lot, explicitly relaying Tonga’s location as another person. The preceding conversation places the direct location report on 14590038.

legacy-review-024.reason: The call says Copy Mason, then turns to Diego with the warrant question. The merchandise reply is to the Diego question, not identification as Mason.

legacy-review-025.reason: The next radio says it will stay in town while the others go. That is an interjection, not approval of the request addressed to Diego; the Diego request is then repeated.

legacy-review-028.reason: The named civilian has a different surname from the roster officer; retain any separately addressed officer candidate.

legacy-review-033--jake-d-laycock.reason: Jake is mentioned as someone already accompanying the caller to lunch. The next radio accepts the open invitation; that does not identify its user as Jake.

legacy-review-034.reason: Brandon is the person being transported, answering the previous question about his name. The later officer giving a location is not thereby Brandon Mason.

legacy-review-036.reason: You shouldn't have used your flashlight is advice to the person who was caught, not a first-person acknowledgment of being Jackie.

legacy-review-038.reason: 14590111 appears to continue its own suspicious-person request and cancel backup. That continuation need not be the answer to the separate Colby hail.

legacy-review-039--mitchell-r-godfrey.reason: The reply says I do not know if he scans, give me a second. That reads as another person trying to reach Mitch rather than identifying the respondent as Mitch.

legacy-review-040.reason: Cox and Richardson are both thanked; this reply is from the Richardson radio already identified in the surrounding conversation. It cannot identify that radio as Cox.

legacy-review-041.reason: Tyler and Meredith Anderson are names supplied in response to an information request. The radio acknowledging them is not thereby Tyler.

legacy-review-043.reason: Tonga is described as a third party who wants to come over. The respondent says they are already there and may address Tonga; this does not identify the respondent as Tonga.

legacy-review-044.reason: Tonga is described as a third party who wants to come over. The respondent says they are already there and may address Tonga; this does not identify the respondent as Tonga.

legacy-review-046.reason: The unclear traffic-stop hail is followed by a different vehicle/location report. The exchange does not clearly establish that this radio answers to Hawkins.

legacy-review-053.reason: Who are you looking for, Renter is a request to identify the intended recipient, not self-identification as Mecham.

legacy-review-056.reason: Luke is described as the person who will come relieve the respondent. The respondent thanking the caller is therefore not identified as Luke by this exchange.

legacy-review-057.reason: 14590073 later addresses David directly: David, the other doors, I got these ones. That is positive contextual reason not to identify 14590073 as David from its earlier which-doors question.

legacy-review-059.reason: The next radio asks a new perimeter question; 14580155 then answers. The new-question transmitter is not established as Cox by the preceding Cox address.
